title: Agent-config JSON/TOML merge, never seed-copy
decision: Handle agent config files as JSON/TOML merge targets during init/update, preserving existing project configuration rather than overwriting.
why: Most projects already have .claude/settings.json with permissions, model, and other settings. Using seed-file copy would fail on existing projects or silently wipe their configuration.
evolution: Founded May 2026 (ms-56fdf2ad); merge pattern established in core.py _merge_claude_hook and _merge_codex_hook functions.
source_quote: `.claude/settings.json` and `.codex/hooks.json` are handled as JSON merge targets during init/update — not seed file copies — so existing agent config is preserved.

supporting.quote: Handle `.claude/settings.json` as a JSON merge rather than a seed file copy.

title: Agent-selective install driven by project.yaml; remove strips only our entries
decision: Memory Seed init installs only chosen agents' files per project.yaml; when removing an agent, strip only Memory Seed entries to preserve foreign configuration in shared directories.
why: Agents may share configuration files like .github/mcp.json. Safe removal preserves existing project configuration and respects agent coexistence in the same workspace.
evolution: Implemented in 2.6.0 (2026-06-13, ms-1bcfcc91); evolved through 2.14.0 with refined UX and participant-count gating.
source_quote: Agent-selective install driven by project.yaml; remove strips only our entries

supporting.quote: init installs only the chosen agents' files; the set is persisted in `.memory-seed/project.yaml`

title: Archive control-plane snapshots before replacing versioned artifacts
decision: Archive prior control-plane snapshots under .memory-seed/archive/<version>/ before replacing reusable versioned artifacts.
why: Preserves audit trail of control-plane evolution and enables recovery if a replacement is found to be incorrect or incomplete.
evolution: Founded from the control file; no session lineage attached yet.
source_quote: Archive prior control-plane snapshots under `.memory-seed/archive/<version>/` before replacing reusable versioned artifacts.

title: Publish via GitHub Release with manual PyPI gate
decision: Publishing is triggered by GitHub Release creation, which activates the publish.yml workflow. The pypi environment has a manual-approval gate that a reviewer must approve before the PyPI push executes.
why: GitHub Release creation produces labeled versions in the Actions UI. Manual approval gate ensures human review before the irreversible PyPI deployment and catches any unintended releases.
evolution: Founded May 2026 (ms-1e38c75c); established as core release policy with multiple releases following the pattern.
source_quote: Publishing should be triggered by GitHub Release creation, not direct workflow dispatch.

supporting.quote: always publish via GitHub Release (`gh release create`), not `gh workflow run`, so the Actions UI shows a labelled version.

title: Trace ships as memory-seed[trace]; core carries no web framework
decision: Memory Trace (Trace UI source and command) ships as an optional extra under memory-seed[trace] install path rather than a separate PyPI project. Plain memory-seed must continue to ship no web framework.
why: Simplifies release coordination and packaging strategy; maintains core lightweight, local-first, and importable without web dependencies.
evolution: Evolved from separate memory-trace project (2026-07-12); folded into root memory-seed[trace] extra to align with commercial packaging and reduce distribution complexity.
source_quote: The release strategy now folds Trace into the root `memory-seed[trace]` install path rather than a separate PyPI project; plain `memory-seed` must still ship no web framework

title: Trace startup incremental; immutable git derivations persist
decision: Memory Trace startup is incremental: immutable git derivations (fork points, commit parents, changed paths) persist across rebuilds, reconciliation is incremental, and file-entry index is lazy.
why: Incremental startup drastically improves performance. Warm start reduced from 44.25s to ~308ms; persisted derivations and lazy indexing enable efficient rebuilds and reconciliation.
evolution: Implemented 2026-07-21 (mse_42e8zzd7); completed the derived-projection plan's final deferred piece.
source_quote: Memory Trace startup is incremental as of 2026-07-21: immutable git derivations (fork points, commit parents, changed paths) persist across rebuilds, reconciliation is incremental, and the file-entry index is lazy.

supporting.quote: Persist immutable git derivations per sha; bulk-read history in single passes

title: Trail derives display lanes without authored graph edges
decision: Trail generates continuity lanes derived from lifecycle edges without requiring or adding authored graph edges.
why: Reduces manual edge annotation burden; derived lanes stay synchronized with true causality and evolution chain topology without user needing to draw additional edges.
evolution: Shipped in Wave 1 (2026-07-15) as part of Trace continuity features; plan documented in docs/5_Completed/evolution-edges-plan.md.
source_quote: Trail derives display lanes without adding authored graph edges.

title: Topology-community detection measured and rejected
decision: Reject topology-community detection for graph layout based on corpus-density measurement. The feature does not gate B0b acceptance.
why: Measured corpus density and found community detection does not improve layout effectiveness for this corpus. Alternative force-based layout achieves the required visualization quality.
evolution: Measured and rejected 2026-07-26 (mse_fud39yw86e7v2uy); decision recorded to document evaluation rather than defer the feature.
source_quote: Topology-community detection was measured and closed 2026-07-26 (rejected, not deferred)

supporting.quote: Topology-community detection was measured and closed

title: Encoding policy owned by Seed, never duplicated in Trace
decision: Encoding policy (UTF-8, LF, NFC normalization) is owned and enforced by Memory Seed core, never duplicated in Memory Trace.
why: Memory Trace depends on the core package. One owner keeps UTF-8/LF/NFC policy, exclusions, and backup behavior consistent across the system.
evolution: Established 2026-07-08 (mse_ejpbz4qqsbdx0hvc); encoding hardening P0 completed with explicit check/repair tooling in Seed.
source_quote: Encoding policy stays owned by Memory Seed rather than being duplicated in Memory Trace, and `doctor` provides a non-fatal summary.

supporting.quote: Keep encoding policy in Memory Seed and add explicit check/repair tooling
